g.title: validated_code_review
g.text: multi-model review pipeline — one simulated run

g.title: cluster_s1
g.text: all parallel · read-only: no builds, no tests
isolated subagents — one fresh context window each

g.title: cluster_s1_focused
g.text: Focused reviewers — model drawn at random

g.title: cluster_s1_broad
g.text: Broad reviewers — one per model, full diff

g.title: cluster_s2
g.text: Stage 2 · Verification by a different model
each claim checked against the code: valid / invalid, graded P0–P2
isolated subagents — one fresh context window each

g.title: cluster_s4
g.text: Stage 4 · Consensus forum — the arbiter of ambiguities

g.title: legend
g.text: your model here — MODELS accepts more
each runs in its own context window; only report
files flow back, so the orchestrator stays clean
no review is verified by its own model.

g.title: setup
g.text: commit log → commits.txt · all artifacts in $REVIEW_DIR

g.title: consolidate
g.text: drop invalid claims · dedupe, keeping highest severity
label broad-review claims as the cross-model stream

g.title: pal
g.text: every model in the list deliberates together
reads the diff, source context, and Stage-3 annotations
settles disputed claims — confirms or rejects each P0/P1
also context-isolated: deliberation happens out-of-process, only verdicts return

g.title: final
g.text: P0 merge blockers lead · P1 follow-ups · vetted P2 nits
each with file:line, evidence, suggested fix
